name: doctor
clue: I help sick people feel better. I listen to your heart.
clue3: You visit me when you have a fever. I check you in my clinic.

name: nurse
clue: I work in a hospital. I help the doctor and take care of patients.
clue3: I wear a uniform and help patients get well. I give injections.

name: dentist
clue: I check your teeth. I tell you to brush every day.
clue3: I fix holes in your teeth. Open your mouth wide!

name: surgeon
clue: I do operations in the hospital to make people well.
clue3: I wear a mask and gloves. I work in the operating room.

name: veterinarian
clue: I am a doctor for animals. I help sick cats and dogs.
clue3: Bring your sick pet to me. I give medicine to cats, dogs, and birds.

name: pharmacist
clue: I give you medicine at the pharmacy.
clue3: Show me the doctor's paper and I give you the right pills.

name: paramedic
clue: I drive an ambulance and help people in an emergency.
clue3: Wee-woo! I come fast in a white car with a red light.

name: optometrist
clue: I check your eyes. I can help you get glasses.
clue3: Read the letters on the chart for me. I test how well you can see.

name: teacher
clue: I work at a school. I help children learn to read and write.
clue3: I stand in front of the class. I write on the board.

name: principal
clue: I am the leader of a school.
clue3: I am the boss of all the teachers at school.

name: librarian
clue: I work in a library. I help you find books.
clue3: Shh! Please be quiet. You can borrow books from me.

name: professor
clue: I teach big students at a university.
clue3: I teach at a university. I know a lot about one subject.

name: scientist
clue: I do experiments in a lab to learn new things.
clue3: I wear a white coat and goggles. I test my ideas.

name: astronomer
clue: I look at the stars and planets with a telescope.
clue3: I watch the night sky. I know the names of the planets.

name: biologist
clue: I study plants and animals with a microscope.
clue3: I study living things, like frogs, trees, and tiny cells.

name: chemist
clue: I mix liquids carefully in a laboratory.
clue3: I mix colorful liquids in glass tubes. Sometimes they bubble!

name: astronaut
clue: I fly a rocket and go to space.
clue3: I wear a big white suit and a helmet. I float in space.

name: pilot
clue: I fly an airplane in the sky.
clue3: I sit in the cockpit. I say, "Please fasten your seat belts."

name: flight attendant
clue: I help passengers on an airplane. I give them drinks.
clue3: I show you the safety rules on the plane. I serve snacks.

name: chef
clue: I cook delicious food in a restaurant kitchen.
clue3: I wear a tall white hat. I am the boss of the kitchen.

name: baker
clue: I make bread and cakes early in the morning.
clue3: I use flour, eggs, and an oven. My shop smells sweet.

name: waiter
clue: I bring food to your table in a restaurant.
clue3: I write your order and bring your food and drinks.

name: barista
clue: I make coffee and hot chocolate in a cafe.
clue3: I draw a heart on top of your coffee in a cafe.

name: butcher
clue: I cut and sell meat in a shop.
clue3: I sell chicken and beef. I use a big knife.

name: pizza maker
clue: I make round food with cheese and tomato.
clue3: I throw the dough in the air. I bake it in a hot oven.

name: ice cream seller
clue: I sell cold and sweet treats on hot days.
clue3: Ding ding! I push a cart and sell cold cones.

name: farmer
clue: I grow rice and vegetables. I drive a tractor.
clue3: I wake up early to feed my animals and work in the field.

name: gardener
clue: I take care of plants and flowers in a garden.
clue3: I water plants, cut the grass, and pull weeds.

name: florist
clue: I sell flowers and make beautiful bouquets.
clue3: I sell roses and tulips in my shop.

name: fisherman
clue: I go to the sea in a boat to catch fish.
clue3: I use a net and a hook. I sell what I catch at the market.

name: beekeeper
clue: I take care of bees and collect honey.
clue3: I wear a special suit and a net on my hat so I do not get stung.

name: rancher
clue: I take care of cows and horses on a big farm.
clue3: I ride a horse and use a rope to take care of cattle.

name: firefighter
clue: I put out fires with water. I drive a red truck.
clue3: I wear a helmet and climb a tall ladder. I use a big hose.

name: police officer
clue: I keep people safe and catch thieves.
clue3: I wear a uniform and a badge. I help you when you are lost.

name: soldier
clue: I protect my country.
clue3: I wear green clothes and a helmet. I march in the army.

name: security guard
clue: I watch the building at night to keep it safe.
clue3: I stand at the gate. I check who comes in.

name: lifeguard
clue: I watch swimmers at the beach and the pool.
clue3: I sit on a tall chair at the pool. I save people who cannot swim.

name: detective
clue: I look for clues to solve mysteries.
clue3: I use a magnifying glass to find out who did it.

name: judge
clue: I listen to both sides and decide in a court.
clue3: I wear a black robe. I hit my wooden hammer and say who is right.

name: lawyer
clue: I help people with the law in court.
clue3: I speak for you in court. I know all the rules.

name: mail carrier
clue: I bring letters to your house.
clue3: I put letters in your mailbox every day.

name: delivery driver
clue: I bring boxes and packages to people.
clue3: Ding dong! Your package is here. I drive a van.

name: bus driver
clue: I drive a big vehicle that takes many people to school and work.
clue3: I stop at every stop to pick up passengers.

name: taxi driver
clue: I drive a yellow car and take you where you want to go.
clue3: You pay me to drive you to the airport or the mall.

name: truck driver
clue: I drive a big vehicle that carries heavy things on long roads.
clue3: My vehicle has many wheels. I drive across the country.

name: train driver
clue: I drive a long vehicle on the railway.
clue3: I drive on rails from station to station. Choo choo!

name: captain
clue: I am the leader of a ship.
clue3: I steer the ship and give orders to the sailors.

name: sailor
clue: I work on a ship on the sea.
clue3: I tie ropes and wear a white hat on the boat.

name: mechanic
clue: I fix cars and motorbikes.
clue3: I change tires and fix engines in a garage.

name: electrician
clue: I fix lights and electric wires.
clue3: I fix plugs and lamps. I am careful with electricity.

name: plumber
clue: I fix water pipes and sinks.
clue3: When your toilet is blocked, call me!

name: carpenter
clue: I make tables and chairs from wood.
clue3: I use a hammer, nails, and a saw to make furniture.

name: builder
clue: I build houses with bricks.
clue3: I use cement and bricks. I wear a hard hat.

name: architect
clue: I draw plans for new buildings.
clue3: I draw the design of a house before it is built.

name: engineer
clue: I design machines, roads, and bridges.
clue3: I use math to make strong bridges and big machines.

name: house painter
clue: I paint the walls of houses.
clue3: I use a big roller and buckets of paint on walls.

name: artist
clue: I paint beautiful pictures with many colors.
clue3: I use a brush and a canvas. My art is in a museum.

name: photographer
clue: I take pictures with my camera.
clue3: Smile! Say cheese! Click!

name: musician
clue: I play music on my guitar.
clue3: I play songs on instruments. I practice every day.

name: singer
clue: I sing songs on the stage.
clue3: I hold a microphone and sing to the crowd.

name: drummer
clue: I play the drums in a band.
clue3: Boom boom! I hit my instrument with two sticks.

name: pianist
clue: I play the piano.
clue3: I press the black and white keys.

name: dancer
clue: I move to the music on the stage.
clue3: I do ballet. I spin on my toes.

name: actor
clue: I act in movies and plays.
clue3: I learn my lines and play a character in a movie.

name: film director
clue: I tell actors what to do when we make a movie.
clue3: I say, "Lights, camera, action!"

name: writer
clue: I write stories and books.
clue3: I use my imagination to write stories for you to read.

name: poet
clue: I write poems with beautiful words.
clue3: My words rhyme, like cat, hat, and bat.

name: journalist
clue: I write news for the newspaper.
clue3: I ask questions and write articles about what happens.

name: news reporter
clue: I tell people what happens today on TV.
clue3: I hold a microphone and tell you about events on TV.

name: radio host
clue: I talk and play songs. You can hear me but you cannot see me.
clue3: I talk into a microphone in a studio. You hear me in the car.

name: DJ
clue: I play music at parties.
clue3: I play songs with turntables and make people dance.

name: programmer
clue: I write code to make apps and games on the computer.
clue3: I type on the keyboard all day to build apps.

name: game designer
clue: I create fun video games.
clue3: I make characters and levels for fun things you play on a computer.

name: cashier
clue: I take your money at the shop.
clue3: Beep! I scan your shopping and give you change.

name: shopkeeper
clue: I sell things in my small shop.
clue3: I open my store in the morning and sell snacks and soap.

name: banker
clue: I work in a bank. I keep money safe.
clue3: I help you save your money and open an account.

name: accountant
clue: I count money and numbers for a company.
clue3: I use a calculator to count money and pay taxes.

name: tailor
clue: I make and fix clothes with a needle and thread.
clue3: I measure you and sew a shirt that fits.

name: fashion designer
clue: I design new clothes and dresses.
clue3: I draw new clothes and show them on a runway.

name: barber
clue: I cut hair for men and boys.
clue3: I use scissors and a razor. I give short haircuts.

name: hairdresser
clue: I cut and style hair in a salon.
clue3: I wash, cut, and curl your hair.

name: cleaner
clue: I clean rooms and floors.
clue3: I use a mop and a broom. I make everything shiny.

name: garbage collector
clue: I take away the trash from the street.
clue3: I ride on a big truck and empty the bins.

name: window cleaner
clue: I clean the windows of tall buildings.
clue3: I hang on a rope high up and wash the glass.

name: football player
clue: I kick the ball and score goals.
clue3: I play on a green field. I wear boots and a jersey.

name: basketball player
clue: I bounce the ball and throw it into the hoop.
clue3: I am very tall. I dribble and shoot.

name: tennis player
clue: I hit a small ball with a racket.
clue3: I hit the ball over the net on a court.

name: swimmer
clue: I race in the pool.
clue3: I wear goggles and a cap. I go fast in the water.

name: cyclist
clue: I ride my bike very fast in races.
clue3: I wear a helmet and pedal very fast.

name: boxer
clue: I wear big gloves in the ring.
clue3: I punch in the ring. I wear big red gloves.

name: coach
clue: I help players train and win.
clue3: I blow my whistle and say, "Run faster!"

name: referee
clue: I make sure players follow the rules of the game.
clue3: I blow a whistle and show a yellow or red card.

name: magician
clue: I do magic tricks with my hat.
clue3: I pull a rabbit out of my hat. Abracadabra!

name: miner
clue: I dig deep under the ground.
clue3: I wear a hard hat with a light. I dig for gold and coal.

name: lumberjack
clue: I cut down trees in the forest.
clue3: I use an axe to chop wood. I wear a checked shirt.

name: locksmith
clue: I make keys and fix locks.
clue3: When you lose your key, I can open your door.

name: jeweler
clue: I make rings and necklaces.
clue3: I work with gold, silver, and shiny diamonds.

name: potter
clue: I make pots and vases from clay.
clue3: I spin wet clay on a wheel to make bowls.

name: tour guide
clue: I show tourists interesting places.
clue3: Follow me! I show you famous places on a trip.

name: receptionist
clue: I welcome guests at the hotel desk.
clue3: I answer the phone and give you your room key.
